bramblehog.name: Bramblehog
bramblehog.desc: A hedgehog whose quills are tiny rose thorns. It sneezes petals.
bramblehog.sighting: It's snuffling through the herb terraces, sneezing little clouds of petals.
summons: {owner}'s Bramblehog rolls into a thorny ball and bounces down the path, sneezing petals the whole way.
The Bramblehog curls up in {owner}'s lap. It is extremely prickly. It is also extremely proud of itself.
{owner}'s Bramblehog sneezes so hard it rolls over backwards, then sneezes again from the new angle.

dewmouse.name: Dewmouse
dewmouse.desc: A mouse no bigger than a thimble that drinks only morning dew.
dewmouse.sighting: It's sipping dew off a blade of grass, one tiny sip at a time.
summons: {owner}'s Dewmouse climbs onto the rim of a teacup and drinks exactly one drop. It looks deeply satisfied.
The Dewmouse washes its whiskers with a single dewdrop, then presents them to {owner} for inspection.
{owner}'s Dewmouse finds a spiderweb full of dew and treats it like an all-you-can-drink buffet.

sunbell_beetle.name: Sunbell Beetle
sunbell_beetle.desc: Its shell rings like a tiny bell whenever the sun comes out.
sunbell_beetle.sighting: Its shell is chiming softly every time the sun peeks out.
summons: {owner}'s Sunbell Beetle flies a slow lap of the room, ringing like a very small church bell.
The Sunbell Beetle lands on {owner}'s nose and rings once, politely, as if announcing them.
{owner}'s Sunbell Beetle plays a tiny tune by flying in and out of a sunbeam.

button_magpie.name: Button Magpie
button_magpie.desc: Collects buttons. Has never once returned one.
button_magpie.sighting: It's strutting past with at least four buttons in its beak.
summons: {owner}'s Button Magpie steals a button off the nearest robe and proudly drops it at {owner}'s feet. It is not returning it.
The Button Magpie shows {owner} its entire button collection, one button at a time, very slowly.
{owner}'s Button Magpie tries to trade someone a button for their shoelace. Negotiations are ongoing.

emberlark.name: Emberlark
emberlark.desc: A songbird with glowing orange wingtips that leave warm little sparks.
emberlark.sighting: It's singing on the rose arch, trailing warm little sparks.
summons: {owner}'s Emberlark sings a bright little song and leaves a trail of glowing sparks that spell nothing in particular.
The Emberlark perches on {owner}'s shoulder and warms their ear like a tiny hearth.
{owner}'s Emberlark does a loop-the-loop and the sparks it leaves behind hang in the air like a sparkler drawing.

seedpup.name: Seedpup
seedpup.desc: A seedling shaped like a puppy that wanders the paths looking for good soil.
seedpup.sighting: It's wandering the paths, sniffing every patch of soil it passes.
summons: {owner}'s Seedpup digs a tiny hole, plants itself in it, and wags its leaves.
The Seedpup sprouts a single flower on its head just for {owner}, then looks very pleased.
{owner}'s Seedpup chases its own roots in a circle until it gets dizzy and flops over.

moonbloom_moth.name: Moonbloom Moth
moonbloom_moth.desc: Pale wings patterned like the Moonbloom Meadow at midnight.
moonbloom_moth.sighting: It's drifting over the Moonbloom Meadow, wings glowing faintly.
summons: {owner}'s Moonbloom Moth settles on the table and its wings light up like a tiny moonlit meadow.
The Moonbloom Moth circles {owner}'s head three times, leaving a silver halo that fades slowly.
{owner}'s Moonbloom Moth opens its wings and, for a moment, the whole room smells like night flowers.

whisperwren.name: Whisperwren
whisperwren.desc: It repeats secrets it overheard - but only ever in whispers.
whisperwren.sighting: It's perched on the crooked bench, whispering something to nobody.
summons: {owner}'s Whisperwren whispers a secret into the nearest ear. It's about who ate the last biscuit.
The Whisperwren sits on {owner}'s shoulder and whispers the entire plot of a book it overheard once.
{owner}'s Whisperwren whispers 'I know what you did.' It does not elaborate. It never elaborates.

mirror_heron.name: Mirror Heron
mirror_heron.desc: Stands so still in the Reflection Pool that its reflection gets bored and wanders off.
mirror_heron.sighting: It's standing perfectly still in the Reflection Pool. Its reflection is not.
summons: {owner}'s Mirror Heron stands utterly still. Its reflection in the nearest window waves hello.
The Mirror Heron stretches one enormous wing over {owner} like an umbrella nobody asked for.
{owner}'s Mirror Heron strikes a dramatic pose, holds it, and waits for applause.

nutkin_dormouse.name: Nutkin Dormouse
nutkin_dormouse.desc: Asleep 23 hours a day. The other hour, it's looking for a better acorn to sleep on.
nutkin_dormouse.sighting: It's curled up asleep on a mossy step. It opened one eye. Barely.
summons: {owner}'s Nutkin Dormouse falls asleep mid-summon. It's snoring. It's adorable.
The Nutkin Dormouse wakes up just long enough to hand {owner} an acorn, then goes back to sleep on it.
{owner}'s Nutkin Dormouse sleepwalks in a very small circle and settles down exactly where it started.

dewdrop_nibbler.name: Dewdrop Nibbler
dewdrop_nibbler.desc: A fuzzy little nibbler that steals anything shiny - dewdrops, moonstones, your earrings - and stuffs it in its belly pouch.
dewdrop_nibbler.sighting: It's rummaging through the flower beds, pouch already bulging with shiny things.
summons: {owner}'s Dewdrop Nibbler pulls a moonstone, three dewdrops, and a silver spoon out of its pouch. Nobody knows whose spoon it is.
The Dewdrop Nibbler eyes someone's earrings with enormous interest. {owner} gently picks it up before anything happens.
{owner}'s Dewdrop Nibbler rolls onto its back to have its belly rubbed. Coins fall out of its pouch everywhere.

starthistle_fox.name: Starthistle Fox
starthistle_fox.desc: A silver fox that only comes out under the stars, with a tail full of tiny lights.
starthistle_fox.sighting: It's slipping between the moonblooms, its tail glittering like a handful of stars.
summons: {owner}'s Starthistle Fox flicks its tail and the room fills with tiny floating lights.
The Starthistle Fox curls around {owner}'s feet and its tail glows like a lantern.
{owner}'s Starthistle Fox leaps, and for a heartbeat it leaves a trail across the room like a shooting star.

pearlshell_snail.name: Pearlshell Snail
pearlshell_snail.desc: Its shell is one enormous pearl. It is extremely smug about this.
pearlshell_snail.sighting: It's inching along the pool steps, shell gleaming, looking very pleased with itself.
summons: {owner}'s Pearlshell Snail turns so everyone can see its shell catch the light. It holds the pose for a long time.
The Pearlshell Snail leaves a shimmering silver trail spelling '{owner}'. It took eleven minutes.
{owner}'s Pearlshell Snail peeks out of its shell, sees an audience, and retreats back in to make a grand entrance.

rosewyrm.name: Rosewyrm
rosewyrm.desc: A tiny dragon that sleeps coiled in the Rose Walk. The roses grow toward it.
rosewyrm.sighting: It's coiled asleep in the Rose Walk, and every rose in the Garden is leaning toward it.
summons: {owner}'s Rosewyrm uncoils and yawns a warm puff of rose-scented smoke. Every flower in the room blooms.
The Rosewyrm wraps itself around {owner}'s shoulders like a scarf of scales and petals, and hums.
{owner}'s Rosewyrm breathes a tiny plume of fire - which turns into a shower of rose petals before it lands.

inkling.name: Inkling
inkling.desc: A tiny ink octopus that lives in inkwells and doodles in the margins.
inkling.sighting: It's peeking out of an inkwell on the reference desk, doodling in the margins.
summons: {owner}'s Inkling draws a tiny portrait of {owner} in the margin of the nearest book. It's surprisingly flattering.
The Inkling squirts a small cloud of ink and writes 'hello' in it before it fades.
{owner}'s Inkling climbs into a teacup and turns the tea navy blue. It thinks this is hilarious.

stackbunny.name: Stackbunny
stackbunny.desc: A dust-grey rabbit that hops between the highest shelves.
stackbunny.sighting: It's hopping between the highest shelves, leaving little dust clouds.
summons: {owner}'s Stackbunny hops to the very top of a bookcase and thumps once, like it's calling a meeting.
The Stackbunny burrows into {owner}'s bag and pops out wearing a bookmark like a tiny hat.
{owner}'s Stackbunny leaves a trail of little dust pawprints across the table. It looks proud of them.

slipfinch.name: Slipfinch
slipfinch.desc: It nests in overdue slips and scolds anyone who returns a book late.
slipfinch.sighting: It's sitting on a stack of overdue slips, chirping disapprovingly.
summons: {owner}'s Slipfinch hands the nearest person an overdue slip. They don't have a library book. The Slipfinch doesn't care.
The Slipfinch chirps a very long, very stern lecture at {owner} about returning things on time.
{owner}'s Slipfinch builds a small nest out of receipts and sits in it smugly.

bookmouse.name: Bookmouse
bookmouse.desc: Lives inside hollowed-out books. Very particular about which ones.
bookmouse.sighting: It's peering out from a hollowed-out book, deciding whether you're worth it.
summons: {owner}'s Bookmouse climbs out of a book, reads the first page of another one, and moves in immediately.
The Bookmouse brings {owner} a pressed violet as a gift, then looks away shyly.
{owner}'s Bookmouse rearranges a whole shelf by colour. It seems very happy about it.

pagebeetle.name: Pagebeetle
pagebeetle.desc: Eats only the words nobody reads anymore.
pagebeetle.sighting: It's munching on the forgotten words in a very old encyclopedia.
summons: {owner}'s Pagebeetle eats a word out of the nearest sentence. Nobody can remember what the sentence was about.
The Pagebeetle burps. The burp comes out in Latin.
{owner}'s Pagebeetle tunnels through a book and comes out the other side, looking wiser.

shushcat.name: Shushcat
shushcat.desc: A sleek black cat that shushes anyone who talks above a whisper.
shushcat.sighting: It's sitting on the returns cart, glaring at anyone who talks too loudly.
summons: {owner}'s Shushcat shushes the whole channel. Everyone feels scolded. Nobody was even talking.
The Shushcat curls up on {owner}'s open book and refuses to move until they start reading quietly.
{owner}'s Shushcat knocks a book off a shelf, then shushes the book for making noise.

glimmerwing.name: Glimmerwing
glimmerwing.desc: A glittering moth that feeds on the gold leaf of old book spines.
glimmerwing.sighting: It's glittering over the old spines, nibbling at the gold leaf.
summons: {owner}'s Glimmerwing flutters around the room, leaving a glittering trail of gold dust.
The Glimmerwing lands on {owner}'s hand and its wings shimmer like a hundred tiny gilded pages.
{owner}'s Glimmerwing finds the one gold-lettered word on a page and sits on it, glowing.

quillhawk.name: Quillhawk
quillhawk.desc: A small hawk with feathers that are, unmistakably, quills.
quillhawk.sighting: It's perched on a lamp, preening its very pointy quill-feathers.
summons: {owner}'s Quillhawk dips a wing in ink and signs {owner}'s name in the air with a flourish.
The Quillhawk swoops over the room and drops a single perfect quill in front of {owner}.
{owner}'s Quillhawk sharpens its feathers on the edge of a desk, then looks at everyone like it's daring them to comment.

footnote_ferret.name: Footnote Ferret
footnote_ferret.desc: Chases footnotes from book to book and never, ever finishes one.
footnote_ferret.sighting: It's darting from book to book, chasing a footnote it will never finish.
summons: {owner}'s Footnote Ferret dives into one book and pops out of a completely different one across the room.
The Footnote Ferret brings {owner} a footnote. The footnote has a footnote. The Ferret goes to get that one too.
{owner}'s Footnote Ferret does a victory dance after finishing a footnote. There's another footnote. The dance stops.

lampwick.name: Lampwick
lampwick.desc: A glowing beetle that lands on whatever page you're struggling to read.
lampwick.sighting: It's glowing over an open book, right on the hardest paragraph.
summons: {owner}'s Lampwick lands on the nearest page and lights up exactly the sentence that was confusing everyone.
The Lampwick circles {owner}'s head like a tiny reading lamp that follows them around.
{owner}'s Lampwick blinks slowly on and off like it's thinking very hard.

gilt_nibbler.name: Gilt Nibbler
gilt_nibbler.desc: Peels the gold leaf off book spines and hoards it. Has stolen at least three reading glasses.
gilt_nibbler.sighting: It's peeling gold leaf off a book spine and stuffing it in its pouch.
summons: {owner}'s Gilt Nibbler produces a gold letter 'G', a pair of reading glasses, and someone's ring from its pouch. It looks innocent.
The Gilt Nibbler polishes a gold coin on {owner}'s sleeve until it gleams, then hides it again.
{owner}'s Gilt Nibbler spots something shiny across the room and freezes, trembling with longing.

rememberowl.name: Rememberowl
rememberowl.desc: An owl that remembers every book ever shelved here - and who borrowed it.
rememberowl.sighting: It's staring down from the top of the stacks, remembering everything.
summons: {owner}'s Rememberowl recites the name of every book {owner} has ever borrowed, and the date they were due.
The Rememberowl looks at someone and says, very clearly, 'You still have my book.'
{owner}'s Rememberowl turns its head all the way around, surveys the room, and nods like it's committing everyone to memory.

folio_chameleon.name: Folio Chameleon
folio_chameleon.desc: Blends perfectly into book covers. You've walked past it a hundred times.
folio_chameleon.sighting: You almost missed it. It's pretending to be the cover of an atlas.
summons: {owner}'s Folio Chameleon disappears against the nearest book. Only its eyes give it away. It blinks.
The Folio Chameleon turns the exact pattern of {owner}'s robes and sits on their shoulder, invisible and smug.
{owner}'s Folio Chameleon cycles through the colours of every book on the shelf, like it's showing off.

codexwyrm.name: Codexwyrm
codexwyrm.desc: A great serpent of living text that coils through the Restricted Section.
codexwyrm.sighting: It's coiling through the Restricted Section, its body made of flowing lines of text.
summons: {owner}'s Codexwyrm unrolls into the air, its body scrolling with glowing words from every book ever written here.
The Codexwyrm curls around {owner} and whispers the last line of a story nobody has finished yet.
{owner}'s Codexwyrm rears up, and for a moment every book in the room flips open to the same page.

cinderwhisk.name: Cinderwhisk
cinderwhisk.desc: A rat with glowing ember whiskers that lights its own way.
cinderwhisk.sighting: It's scurrying along the corridor, its ember whiskers lighting the way.
summons: {owner}'s Cinderwhisk lights up its whiskers like a tiny torch and leads everyone on a tour of the dark corners.
The Cinderwhisk curls up by {owner}'s feet, glowing like a little campfire.
{owner}'s Cinderwhisk sneezes and a puff of sparks goes up. It looks embarrassed.

rustbeetle.name: Rustbeetle
rustbeetle.desc: Eats rust. Leaves old locks looking brand new and very confused.
rustbeetle.sighting: It's chewing the rust off an old lock, leaving it shiny and confused.
summons: {owner}'s Rustbeetle cleans the nearest doorknob until it gleams, then moves on to the next one.
The Rustbeetle climbs onto {owner}'s belt buckle and polishes it with great seriousness.
{owner}'s Rustbeetle eats a rusty nail and makes a satisfied clicking noise.

linkling.name: Linkling
linkling.desc: A little snake made of chain links that rattles when it's happy.
linkling.sighting: It's slithering across the floor, rattling happily.
summons: {owner}'s Linkling coils into a tidy spiral and rattles like applause.
The Linkling wraps around {owner}'s wrist like a very affectionate bracelet.
{owner}'s Linkling ties itself in a knot, gets stuck, and rattles for help. {owner} untangles it.

cistern_toad.name: Cistern Toad
cistern_toad.desc: It croaks in perfect time with the dripping cistern.
cistern_toad.sighting: It's sitting by the cistern, croaking in time with the drips.
summons: {owner}'s Cistern Toad croaks a perfect drumbeat. Someone in the channel starts nodding along.
The Cistern Toad hops into a cup of water and sits in it like a very small king in a bath.
{owner}'s Cistern Toad croaks once, deeply. The echo lasts far longer than it should.

keyhole_bat.name: Keyhole Bat
keyhole_bat.desc: Sleeps inside keyholes. Very annoying if you need the door.
keyhole_bat.sighting: It's hanging upside down inside a keyhole. The door is very much locked now.
summons: {owner}'s Keyhole Bat folds itself up impossibly small and tucks into the nearest keyhole.
The Keyhole Bat hangs from {owner}'s sleeve and squeaks the tune of a lullaby.
{owner}'s Keyhole Bat flutters around the room and lands upside down on the ceiling, satisfied.

mossback_newt.name: Mossback Newt
mossback_newt.desc: Grows a little garden of cellar moss on its back.
mossback_newt.sighting: It's basking on a damp stone, a tiny moss garden growing on its back.
summons: {owner}'s Mossback Newt shows off its back garden. A tiny mushroom has sprouted since yesterday.
The Mossback Newt climbs onto {owner}'s hand, and a little moss flower opens on its back.
{owner}'s Mossback Newt lies very still so a ladybird can land in its garden. It does.

coin_crab.name: Coin Crab
coin_crab.desc: Uses old coins as a shell and trades up whenever it can.
coin_crab.sighting: It's scuttling out of the storeroom wearing an ancient coin as a shell.
summons: {owner}'s Coin Crab clacks its claws and offers to trade shells with anyone who has a shinier coin.
The Coin Crab climbs onto {owner}'s palm and spins its coin-shell like a tiny top.
{owner}'s Coin Crab counts its coins out loud, click by click. It loses count and starts again.

chalkshade_ferret.name: Chalkshade Ferret
chalkshade_ferret.desc: Draws doorways on the walls in chalk, then disappears through them.
chalkshade_ferret.sighting: It's drawing a chalk door on the wall - and it's about to go through it.
summons: {owner}'s Chalkshade Ferret draws a door on the wall, dives through it, and pops out of a different chalk door behind everyone.
The Chalkshade Ferret draws a chalk portrait of {owner} on the floor. It's mostly nose.
{owner}'s Chalkshade Ferret draws a tiny chalk hat, puts it on, and wears it proudly.

grateling.name: Grateling
grateling.desc: The thing breathing under the drainage grate. It's shy, actually.
grateling.sighting: Something is peeking out from the drainage grate. It's very shy. It's waving.
summons: {owner}'s Grateling peeks out, waves eight small legs at everyone, and hides again.
The Grateling spins a tiny web that spells '{owner}' and then looks away bashfully.
{owner}'s Grateling breathes in a slow, calm rhythm. Somehow the whole channel relaxes a little.

waxwing_moth.name: Waxwing Moth
waxwing_moth.desc: Its wings are dripping candle wax that never burns out.
waxwing_moth.sighting: It's fluttering near a candle stub, wax dripping from its glowing wings.
summons: {owner}'s Waxwing Moth lands on a table and its wings light like two small candles.
The Waxwing Moth flutters around {owner}, dripping little wax stars that harden where they land.
{owner}'s Waxwing Moth dims its wings to a gentle glow, like a nightlight that loves you.

coinpurse_nibbler.name: Coinpurse Nibbler
coinpurse_nibbler.desc: Its pouch jingles with old coins. It will absolutely try to pick your pocket.
coinpurse_nibbler.sighting: It's sniffing around the old cells, its pouch jingling with stolen coins.
summons: {owner}'s Coinpurse Nibbler empties its pouch: coins, a spoon, a key, and somebody's wedding ring. It puts it all back fast.
The Coinpurse Nibbler tries to pick {owner}'s pocket, gets caught, and pretends it was a hug.
{owner}'s Coinpurse Nibbler balances on its tail and juggles three stolen coins.

hinge_hound.name: Hinge Hound
hinge_hound.desc: An iron pup that guards the sealed door and wags its whole body.
hinge_hound.sighting: It's sitting in front of the iron door, wagging its whole clanking body.
summons: {owner}'s Hinge Hound wags so hard its whole body creaks like an old door.
The Hinge Hound sits at {owner}'s feet and guards them very seriously from absolutely nothing.
{owner}'s Hinge Hound fetches a rusty bolt, drops it at {owner}'s feet, and waits with its tail squeaking.

pale_warren_hare.name: Pale Warren-Hare
pale_warren_hare.desc: A see-through hare that only appears in the old cells after dark.
pale_warren_hare.sighting: A see-through hare is sitting in the old cells, glowing faintly in the dark.
summons: {owner}'s Pale Warren-Hare hops straight through the nearest wall and back again, glowing softly.
The Pale Warren-Hare sits beside {owner}, and everything nearby goes calm and moonlit.
{owner}'s Pale Warren-Hare thumps a foot, and a gentle chill runs through the channel.

emberwarden.name: Emberwarden
emberwarden.desc: A great salamander that has kept the forgotten shrine's flame alive for centuries.
emberwarden.sighting: The great salamander is lying across the shrine, the old flame flickering on its back.
summons: {owner}'s Emberwarden raises its head and every candle in the room lights at once.
The Emberwarden curls around {owner}, warm as a hearth, and the old shrine flame dances on its back.
{owner}'s Emberwarden breathes out slowly, and the air fills with drifting golden embers that never burn.

mossback_tortoise.name: Mossback Tortoise
mossback_tortoise.desc: So old and slow that a small forest grows on its shell.
mossback_tortoise.sighting: It's plodding past the treeline with a small forest growing on its shell.
summons: {owner}'s Mossback Tortoise arrives. Eventually. A bird has built a nest in its shell-forest on the way.
The Mossback Tortoise stretches out its neck and blinks slowly at {owner}. It's the most peaceful thing in the world.
{owner}'s Mossback Tortoise grows a single new flower in its shell-forest, just for this moment.

blackcap_squirrel.name: Blackcap Squirrel
blackcap_squirrel.desc: A black squirrel that buries acorns and forgets on purpose.
blackcap_squirrel.sighting: It's burying acorns under the brambles and immediately forgetting where.
summons: {owner}'s Blackcap Squirrel buries an acorn in someone's hood and runs away giggling.
The Blackcap Squirrel sits on {owner}'s head and chatters at everyone like it owns the place.
{owner}'s Blackcap Squirrel digs up an acorn, looks at it, and reburies it in exactly the same spot.

tattlecrow.name: Tattlecrow
tattlecrow.desc: A crow that tells everyone exactly who's been in the Woods.
tattlecrow.sighting: It's on a branch at the treeline, cawing the names of everyone who's been out here.
summons: {owner}'s Tattlecrow caws the name of the last person who snuck into the Woods. Everyone turns to look at them.
The Tattlecrow lands on {owner}'s shoulder and tattles on them. Loudly. To everyone.
{owner}'s Tattlecrow brings {owner} a shiny beetle and a very juicy piece of gossip.

mistweasel.name: Mistweasel
mistweasel.desc: Made half of fur and half of mist. Mostly mist.
mistweasel.sighting: It's winding through the mist in the clearing. Or it's just mist. Hard to tell.
summons: {owner}'s Mistweasel curls around their neck like a soft, cool scarf of fog.
The Mistweasel dissolves into mist, drifts across the room, and reappears on the other side.
{owner}'s Mistweasel pops out of a cup of tea as a puff of steam and looks very pleased with itself.

stonebadger.name: Stonebadger
stonebadger.desc: Digs its den under the standing stones and guards them fiercely.
stonebadger.sighting: It's digging under the standing stones and grumbling at anyone who gets close.
summons: {owner}'s Stonebadger digs a burrow under the table and grumbles from inside it.
The Stonebadger sits beside {owner} like a very small, very stubborn bodyguard.
{owner}'s Stonebadger rolls a pebble over to {owner} as a gift. It's a very good pebble.

thornpiglet.name: Thornpiglet
thornpiglet.desc: A wild piglet with bramble bristles. Charges things. Misses.
thornpiglet.sighting: It's charging at a tree. It missed. It's charging again.
summons: {owner}'s Thornpiglet charges bravely across the room. It misses the target entirely. It's thrilled anyway.
The Thornpiglet snuffles around {owner}'s feet and squeals happily when it finds a dropped crumb.
{owner}'s Thornpiglet rolls in the mud and comes out looking extremely proud of its new outfit.

frostfin.name: Frostfin
frostfin.desc: A trout that swims under the frozen stream, keeping it from freezing solid.
frostfin.sighting: It's swimming under the ice of the frozen stream, keeping a little patch of water open.
summons: {owner}'s Frostfin leaps out of a glass of water and leaves a sparkle of frost in the air.
The Frostfin swims in a slow circle, and the water around it clears like glass.
{owner}'s Frostfin flicks its tail and a tiny snowflake lands on {owner}'s nose.

duskpup.name: Duskpup
duskpup.desc: A wolf cub that's lost its pack and howls very small howls.
duskpup.sighting: A lost wolf cub is sitting on the trail, howling a very small howl.
summons: {owner}'s Duskpup lets out a tiny howl. Somewhere very far away, something howls back. The Duskpup is delighted.
The Duskpup chews {owner}'s sleeve, then falls asleep mid-chew.
{owner}'s Duskpup chases its own tail, catches it, and has no idea what to do next.

hollowhoot.name: Hollowhoot
hollowhoot.desc: An owl that lives in the hollow log and hoots in riddles.
hollowhoot.sighting: It's peering out of the hollow log, hooting something that sounds like a riddle.
summons: {owner}'s Hollowhoot hoots a riddle. Nobody can solve it. It hoots smugly.
The Hollowhoot tilts its head at {owner} almost upside down, as if they're the riddle.
{owner}'s Hollowhoot hoots the answer to yesterday's riddle. It was 'a candle'. It's always a candle.

rootling.name: Rootling
rootling.desc: A walking bundle of roots with two bright green eyes.
rootling.sighting: A bundle of roots with two bright green eyes is shuffling along the path.
summons: {owner}'s Rootling plants its feet, wiggles its toes into the ground, and sprouts a leaf of pure joy.
The Rootling wraps a little root around {owner}'s finger, like a handshake.
{owner}'s Rootling does a slow, creaky dance. Several mushrooms sprout where it stepped.

glimmer_nibbler.name: Glimmer Nibbler
glimmer_nibbler.desc: Collects anything that glints in the dark - fangs, beetle shells, lost buckles - and buries them in a secret hoard.
glimmer_nibbler.sighting: It's rooting around the old hunting blind, stuffing anything that glints into its pouch.
summons: {owner}'s Glimmer Nibbler digs up its secret hoard: fangs, beetle shells, a lost buckle, and someone's missing spoon.
The Glimmer Nibbler eyes the shiny clasp on {owner}'s robes. {owner} holds it closed. The Nibbler sulks.
{owner}'s Glimmer Nibbler finds a single glinting pebble and treats it like the treasure of the century.

lanternback_stag.name: Lanternback Stag
lanternback_stag.desc: Its antlers glow with cold blue witchlight in the dark.
lanternback_stag.sighting: Blue witchlight is glowing between the trees. It's coming from a stag's antlers.
summons: {owner}'s Lanternback Stag lowers its head, and its antlers light the whole room in cold, beautiful blue.
The Lanternback Stag walks a slow circle around {owner}, leaving little floating witchlights behind.
{owner}'s Lanternback Stag raises its antlers to the sky, and they blaze like a lighthouse in a storm.

starpond_otter.name: Starpond Otter
starpond_otter.desc: Swims in the black pond at night, juggling reflected stars.
starpond_otter.sighting: It's floating on its back in the black pond, juggling reflected stars.
summons: {owner}'s Starpond Otter juggles three tiny stars and catches them all without looking.
The Starpond Otter floats on its back and hands {owner} a single glowing star to hold.
{owner}'s Starpond Otter dives, and ripples of starlight spread across the whole channel.

hushelk.name: Hushelk
hushelk.desc: A vast white elk that moves without a sound. The whole forest goes quiet around it.
hushelk.sighting: The forest has gone completely silent. A huge white elk is standing in the clearing.
summons: {owner}'s Hushelk steps forward, and for one long moment the whole channel falls perfectly, peacefully quiet.
The Hushelk lowers its great head to {owner}. Snow begins to fall, softly, from nowhere.
{owner}'s Hushelk looks up, and every sound in the room fades to a hush as if the world is listening.

gearmouse.name: Gearmouse
gearmouse.desc: A clockwork mouse that winds itself up and runs laps around the orrery.
gearmouse.sighting: It's running laps around the orrery, winding itself up as it goes.
summons: {owner}'s Gearmouse winds its own key, runs three laps of the room, and ticks happily.
The Gearmouse climbs into {owner}'s pocket and ticks like a heartbeat.
{owner}'s Gearmouse runs down, stops, and waits patiently for someone to wind it back up.

northless_crab.name: Northless Crab
northless_crab.desc: It walks sideways because it has never once known which way is north.
northless_crab.sighting: It's scuttling sideways across the deck, completely lost.
summons: {owner}'s Northless Crab points confidently in a direction. It is not north. It has never been north.
The Northless Crab scuttles in a perfect circle, looking for north. It ends up back beside {owner}.
{owner}'s Northless Crab waves its claws at the sky, as if asking the stars for directions.

chartfinch.name: Chartfinch
chartfinch.desc: Builds its nest out of old star charts, in the right constellation order.
chartfinch.sighting: It's building a nest out of old star charts, arranging them in the right order.
summons: {owner}'s Chartfinch arranges some crumbs into a perfect little constellation.
The Chartfinch perches on {owner}'s finger and sings the names of the stars in order.
{owner}'s Chartfinch tucks a scrap of star chart behind {owner}'s ear like a gift.

domedove.name: Domedove
domedove.desc: Roosts in the dome and coos whenever a star falls.
domedove.sighting: It's roosting at the top of the dome, cooing up at the sky.
summons: {owner}'s Domedove coos softly, and somewhere a star falls just to be polite.
The Domedove settles on {owner}'s shoulder and preens their hair gently.
{owner}'s Domedove flies a loop of the dome and lands exactly where it started, very pleased.

cogbeetle.name: Cogbeetle
cogbeetle.desc: Its shell is a tiny brass gear that actually turns.
cogbeetle.sighting: Its brass-gear shell is turning slowly as it climbs the old telescope.
summons: {owner}'s Cogbeetle spins its gear-shell, and a tiny music-box tune plays.
The Cogbeetle locks into a gear in the nearest clock and keeps perfect time.
{owner}'s Cogbeetle climbs onto {owner}'s hand and ticks along with their pulse.

spiral_gecko.name: Spiral Gecko
spiral_gecko.desc: Runs up and down the spiral stair all day. Dizzy. Happy.
spiral_gecko.sighting: It's zooming up and down the spiral stair. Again. And again.
summons: {owner}'s Spiral Gecko runs up the wall, across the ceiling, and down again, very dizzy and very happy.
The Spiral Gecko stops, wobbles, and falls over. It gets back up and does it again.
{owner}'s Spiral Gecko curls into a perfect spiral and falls asleep.

meteorkit.name: Meteorkit
meteorkit.desc: A fox kit with a meteorite tail that sparks when it wags.
meteorkit.sighting: It's pouncing at falling sparks on the viewing deck, tail glowing.
summons: {owner}'s Meteorkit wags its tail and a shower of little sparks rains down like a tiny meteor storm.
The Meteorkit pounces on a falling spark, misses, and pounces on {owner} instead.
{owner}'s Meteorkit curls up and its tail glows like a comet settling down for the night.

moonglass_owl.name: Moonglass Owl
moonglass_owl.desc: Its eyes are two perfect moonglass lenses. It sees the whole sky.
moonglass_owl.sighting: It's perched on the telescope, its moonglass eyes reflecting the whole sky.
summons: {owner}'s Moonglass Owl turns its eyes toward {owner}, and for a moment {owner} can see the whole night sky in them.
The Moonglass Owl focuses on something very far away and nods, like it's seen something wonderful.
{owner}'s Moonglass Owl blinks slowly, and the stars in its eyes rearrange into a smile.

orbitcat.name: Orbitcat
orbitcat.desc: Sleeps curled around the orrery's sun and bats at passing planets.
orbitcat.sighting: It's curled around the orrery's sun, batting at the planets as they pass.
summons: {owner}'s Orbitcat bats a tiny planet across the room and chases it in a perfect orbit.
The Orbitcat curls around {owner} like they're the sun, and purrs.
{owner}'s Orbitcat knocks a moon off the orrery, looks directly at {owner}, and does it again.

stardrop_newt.name: Stardrop Newt
stardrop_newt.desc: Speckled like the night sky. The speckles move.
stardrop_newt.sighting: Its speckles are drifting across its back like slow-moving stars.
summons: {owner}'s Stardrop Newt's speckles rearrange into {owner}'s initials.
The Stardrop Newt sits very still while its spots slowly spin like a galaxy.
{owner}'s Stardrop Newt licks a speckle off its own back and it floats up into the air like a firefly.

stardust_nibbler.name: Stardust Nibbler
stardust_nibbler.desc: Sneaks up to the roof to steal fallen stardust. Its pouch glows faintly at night.
stardust_nibbler.sighting: It's sneaking across the roof, scooping fallen stardust into its glowing pouch.
summons: {owner}'s Stardust Nibbler opens its pouch and a cloud of glittering stardust puffs out. It quickly stuffs it back in.
The Stardust Nibbler steals a sparkle from the nearest candle flame. Nobody knows how.
{owner}'s Stardust Nibbler hands {owner} a single speck of stardust, then immediately tries to take it back.

cometail_hare.name: Cometail Hare
cometail_hare.desc: Leaves a shimmering trail of comet dust across the viewing deck at night.
cometail_hare.sighting: A hare is racing across the viewing deck, leaving a shimmering trail of comet dust.
summons: {owner}'s Cometail Hare races a loop of the room and leaves a glowing tail that hangs in the air.
The Cometail Hare sits up tall beside {owner}, ears twitching toward the stars.
{owner}'s Cometail Hare leaps so high it seems to hang among the stars for a moment before landing.

cloudwhale_calf.name: Cloudwhale Calf
cloudwhale_calf.desc: A baby whale made of cloud that floats around the top of the dome.
cloudwhale_calf.sighting: A small whale made of cloud is floating near the top of the dome.
summons: {owner}'s Cloudwhale Calf drifts across the room and sings a low, soft song that makes everyone sleepy.
The Cloudwhale Calf floats down and nuzzles {owner}, leaving them slightly damp and very happy.
{owner}'s Cloudwhale Calf blows a tiny rain cloud out of its spout. It rains on exactly one person.

starling_drake.name: Starling Drake
starling_drake.desc: A dragon whose scales are a map of the sky. Only seen when the stars are out.
starling_drake.sighting: The sky over the dome is moving. It's a dragon, and its scales are a map of the stars.
summons: {owner}'s Starling Drake unfurls its wings, and the ceiling fills with a moving map of the night sky.
The Starling Drake curls around {owner}, and a new constellation shaped like the two of them appears overhead.
{owner}'s Starling Drake breathes out a gentle stream of starlight that settles on everyone like glitter.
